node.statement: For a 2-by-2 block matrix Z=(Z_ij), Ruan scalar multiplication and direct-sum axioms give ||[A B]||<=sqrt(2) max{||A||,||B||} (factor through diag(A,B) and the scalar row [1 1]); applying the same argument to the two block rows gives ||Z||<=2 max_ij||Z_ij||. Scalar corner compressions give the reverse individual bounds ||Z_ij||<=||Z||.
